Does this sound familiar?

You give everything, and still feel unchosen

  • You perform, over-give and over-function to be loved.
  • You leave yourself behind the moment someone new comes in.
  • You fall for his potential instead of what is actually in front of you.
  • You can’t quite tell what your own yes and no feel like any more.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five shifts we’ll make together, live

Why chasing love keeps you leaving yourself

The pattern behind performing and over-giving, and why working harder for love never makes you feel more chosen.

How to feel your yes and your no

A simple somatic check-in to hear what your body already knows, before your head talks you out of it.

How to stop falling for potential

See what is really there, trust your intuition, and stop waiting for someone to become who you hoped.

Boundaries that come from self-trust

Saying what you need without over-explaining, and staying with yourself when it feels uncomfortable.

Expressing yourself without needing permission

Building the inner safety that doesn’t depend on anyone’s validation, so you can show up as all of you.

Before you save your seat

Who is this class for?

Women who are tired of performing for love and are ready to trust themselves, hold their boundaries and express who they really are.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Why is it free?

Because the first step back to yourself should be easy. Come, feel the work, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “The performance”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Over-giving is not the same as being loved.”

Body

“So many women are performing for love without realising it. Saying yes when the body says no. Doing more, giving more, hoping to finally be chosen. It doesn’t work, because love you have to earn by leaving yourself behind was never the love you wanted.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class called Stop Chasing Love. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: close-up talking to camera, soft natural light, same setup as your talking reels.

Script 2 · “Your yes and your no”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your body knows your answer before your head does.”

Body

“There’s a feeling in the body for yes and a feeling for no. When we spend years trying to be chosen, we stop listening to it. Self-trust starts when you hear it again, and boundaries get so much easier from there.”

CTA

“In my free class I’ll guide you through a simple somatic check-in, live. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, then a slow cut to hands on chest for the check-in.

Script 3 · “Potential”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Falling for someone’s potential is a way of abandoning yourself.”

Body

“It feels like hope. But waiting for someone to become who you need means you stop listening to what is actually in front of you, and to your own intuition. Trusting yourself is what changes the pattern.”

CTA

“Join my free live class, Stop Chasing Love. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “potential” in your serif type.
